gloss: to slip into; to get mixed in; to blend into

definitions.gloss: to slip into; to sneak in; to get mixed in
definitions.explanation: To enter or become part of a group or place unnoticed, either intentionally or accidentally. Describes someone or something blending in with surroundings or a crowd without being detected.

definitions.gloss: to get mixed in among; to become lost among
definitions.explanation: For an object or item to become indistinguishable among others, making it difficult to find or separate.

examples.japanese: {人混|ひとご}みに{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}む。
{不審者|ふしんしゃ}がイベント{会場|かいじょう}に{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: A suspicious person slipped into the event venue.

examples.japanese: {野良猫|のらねこ}がいつの{間|ま}にか{家|いえ}の{中|なか}に{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}んでいた。
examples.english: A stray cat had somehow slipped into the house without anyone noticing.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}の{中|なか}に{古|ふる}い{手紙|てがみ}が{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}んでいた。
examples.english: An old letter had gotten mixed in among the documents.

examples.japanese: {偽物|にせもの}が{本物|ほんもの}の{中|なか}に{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}んでいる。
examples.english: Counterfeits are mixed in among the genuine articles.

examples.japanese: {大量|たいりょう}の{荷物|にもつ}の{中|なか}に{壊|こわ}れた{品物|しなもの}が{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}んでいないか{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check whether any damaged items have gotten mixed in among the large shipment.

notes:
Compound of {紛|まぎ}れる (to become indistinguishable, to blend) and {込|こ}む (directional suffix indicating going inward). The {込|こ}む suffix adds the nuance of entering or penetrating into something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人混|ひとご}みに{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}む: to slip into a crowd
- {群衆|ぐんしゅう}に{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}む: to blend into a throng
- {書類|しょるい}に{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}む: to get mixed in with documents
- {荷物|にもつ}に{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}む: to get mixed in with luggage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {忍|しの}び{込|こ}む: to sneak in — emphasizes stealth and deliberate intent, often for a criminal purpose
- {入|はい}り{込|こ}む: to enter, go into — neutral; simply describes going inside without the nuance of blending in
- {混|ま}じる: to be mixed — describes the state of being blended rather than the action of slipping in
